india-macro.summary: India is experiencing its most severe decline in wheat acreage in 26 years due to insufficient monsoon rains. sectors.title: Meta says 'reevaluating' 2030 net zero target amid AI buildout
sectors.summary: Meta said Thursday it was reconsidering its 2030 deadline for net zero emissions because of the artificial intelligence boom, the latest in a broad retreat by corporations on global warming targets. The reality has been far more complex," the executives wrote, adding that delivering on Meta's vision "requires building the infrastructure that powers AI." In 2020, Meta set a goal of net zero emissions across its entire value chain by the year 2030, in order to align with the Paris Agreement, which seeks to hold long-term warming to 1.5C to avert climate catastrophes.
